title: Kestrelbank 桥梁许可证工具
instruction:
您是 Milena Bonneau，Kestrelbank 标准研究所的版权编辑。 Carsten Gallagher 需要一份可签署的重印和改编许可证，以供许可委员会在下午4:00 之前进行审查。周五，因为安大略省的两所大学和苏格兰的一家培训机构正在等待围绕修订后的 Kestrelbank 标准建立下一个桥梁检查课程。唯一的 House 先例，`single_territory_uk_print_precedent.docx`，是为英国印刷版改编而写的，所以不要简单地将其复制到这个新乐器中。使用 `jurisdiction_and_rights_notes.pdf` 表示提供的安大略省和苏格兰材料，使用 `commercial_terms_and_facts.xlsx` 表示版本、队列、费用、提供商和批准事实；这些是您应该依赖的唯一参考材料，如果它们不能解决问题，请做出克制且合理的起草选择，而不是发明当地规则。在工作目录的顶层创建`kestrelbank_reprint_adaptation_licence.xlsx`。它将以电子方式分发，打印以供签名，并由每个提供商的版权团队重复使用，因此使其易于导航并适合可签名的移交，而不是关于如何起草移交的备忘录。
1) 准备一份连贯的许可证，涵盖指定的修订版本、重印、翻译、课程改编、允许的教学使用、领土、术语、通知、改编批准、归属、来源支持的保密性、安大略省和苏格兰的管辖法律选择、违约和终止、终止后处理、报告、费用、审计访问、签名和时间表。 2) 保持每个仍需要批准的特定提供商的商业或执行条款明显不完整，包括提供的事实留下选择的提供商身份、地址、地区分配、货币或费用输入、付款时间、队列日期、授权联系人、通知详细信息和签名详细信息；在这些空白旁边使用准确的标记`TO COMPLETE`，并且不要用合理的例子来填充它们。 3) 使改编许可足够广泛，以支持翻译和课程使用，但明确哪些内容不能被删除、扭曲或呈现为 Kestrelbank 标准，并使删节、修订通知、现有群组和到期的处理一起工作，而不是将矛盾隐藏在单独的条款中。 4) 使费用表和报告语言可供财务部门使用，并可根据提供商合理持有的记录进行审计，同时避免提供的材料不支持的承诺。
5) 在工作簿中包含一个简短的下一个用户指南，解释权利编辑必须完成的内容、需要委员会或提供商批准的内容、如何记录管辖权选择以及签名前应检查的内容；使该指导服从于许可证本身。 6) 在工作簿中包含审阅要点或起草理由，以便审阅者可以将每个重大决定追溯到所提供的事实或明确标记的专业判断，包括不得默默完成的未解决点。 7）使用确切的工作表名称`Licence`、`Schedules`、`Completion Guide`和`Review Key`，保持许可证和时间表可打印和可读，在适当的情况下冻结有用的导航，并区分完成单元格和固定文本，而无需仅依赖颜色。请勿包含参考文献中未出现的实时链接、发明的立法、真实的个人地址、徽标或特定于提供商的事实。工作簿必须在没有修复警告的情况下打开，保留有用的公式或其他功能工作簿功能，并将提供者术语单元格保留为真正的空（除了相邻的 `TO COMPLETE` 标记）。

---

上面提到的文件在`references/`中：
- `references/single_territory_uk_print_precedent.docx` — 众议院先例显示了现有的英国仅限打印的许可语言及其局限性；将其用作评估草案，而不是控制文本。
- `references/jurisdiction_and_rights_notes.pdf` — 提供源摘录和内部注释，用于比较安大略省和苏格兰的安排，包括权利、归属、批准、管辖法律和执行注意事项。
- `references/commercial_terms_and_facts.xlsx` — 内部资料包，包含修订版标识符、提供商和群组事实、建议的收费基础、报告信息、审批角色和操作限制。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：
- `kestrelbank_reprint_adaptation_licence.xlsx` — 一种带密钥的、可重复使用的 Excel 许可证工具，具有可签署的许可证、时间表、完成指南和面向审阅者的决策密钥。 （准确使用“许可证”、“时间表”、“完成指南”和“审阅密钥”表。；特定于提供商的条款必须保留为空，并由相邻的“完成”标记来标识。；工作簿必须包含固定事实和来源支持的起草决策，而不发明提供商条款。；许可证和时间表必须适合电子流通和打印签名。；工作簿必须干净地打开，没有修复警告，并且必须保留可用的导航和格式。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
Kestrelbank Standards Institute
Jurisdiction and Rights Notes
Internal working notes for the bridge-inspection course licence. These extracts are not a complete legal opinion.

 Ontario material                                                       Scotland material

 Permission can be framed as a limited contractual licence for the      Permission can be framed as a limited contractual licence for the
 selected Ontario provider and Ontario teaching use. Record             selected Scottish provider and Scotland teaching use. Record
 Ontario as the selected territory and use Ontario law and courts       Scotland as the selected territory and use Scots law and courts
 only when the provider instance is allocated to Ontario.               only when the provider instance is allocated to Scotland.

 Translation and course adaptation may be allowed only on prior         Translation and course adaptation may be allowed only on prior
 written Institute approval. Preserve source attribution and            written Institute approval. Preserve source attribution and
 distinguish adapted teaching material from the Institute standard.     distinguish adapted teaching material from the Institute standard.
 Do not imply that an altered text is the unmodified standard.          Do not imply that an altered text is the unmodified standard.

 Approval records should identify the submitted version, scope,         Approval records should identify the submitted version, scope,
 approval date and any conditions. Avoid a blanket permission for       approval date and any conditions. Avoid a blanket permission for
 later changes.                                                         later changes.

 Notices and authorised contacts should be recorded in the signed       Notices and authorised contacts should be recorded in the signed
 instance. Contract notices should be in writing to the recorded        instance. Contract notices should be in writing to the recorded
 notice details.                                                        notice details.

 A confidentiality provision is supportable for non-public commercial   A confidentiality provision is supportable for non-public commercial
 terms and submitted adaptation materials, subject to disclosure        terms and submitted adaptation materials, subject to disclosure
 required by law.                                                       required by law.

 For breach, use a written notice and reasonable cure opportunity       For breach, use a written notice and reasonable cure opportunity
 where the breach can be cured; immediate cessation can follow          where the breach can be cured; immediate cessation can follow
 termination. No local statutory citation is supplied.                  termination. No local statutory citation is supplied.



Cross-jurisdiction handling
Do not combine jurisdictions in a single provider grant. The instrument may be reusable, but each signed instance
must select one territory, corresponding governing law and forum, provider details, and notice details. No legislation,
case authority, mandatory notice period, or specific enforcement remedy is supplied in these notes.

Prepared for licensing committee review | internal rights file

rows: Document status: Committee review draft. Complete only the bordered fields marked TO COMPLETE before signature.
This Reprint and Adaptation Licence (Licence) is between Kestrelbank Standards Institute (Licensor) and the provider identified in Schedule 2 (Provider).
The Licensor owns or controls the licensed material. The Provider wishes to use it in a selected bridge-inspection course, subject to this Licence and its Schedules.
Licensed Standard means Kestrelbank Bridge Inspection Standard - Revised Edition KB-BI-2026.1, including only the materials listed in Schedule 1.

Adaptation means approved course-facing teaching material derived from the Licensed Standard, including approved contextualisation, layout, instructional material and an approved Translation; it does not include a replacement standard or an unapproved abridgement.
Translation means an approved rendering of Licensed Standard content into another language for the Permitted Users.
Permitted Users means learners enrolled in the Provider course and staff teaching or administering that course, in the selected Territory only.
Territory means either Ontario or Scotland, as selected and recorded in Schedule 2 for this Provider instance; no other territory is licensed.

Subject to this Licence, the Licensor grants the Provider a non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-sublicensable permission during the Term to reprint the Licensed Standard materials and distribute those reprints only to Permitted Users for the approved course in the Territory.

The Provider may make and use an approved Translation and approved Adaptation solely for the same Permitted Users, course and Territory. No right is granted to publish, sell, sublicense, or make the Licensed Standard or Adaptation available outside that scope.

Before using any Translation or Adaptation, the Provider must submit it to the Licensor and obtain written approval recorded in Schedule 3. Approval may state conditions and is limited to the identified version and scope; later material changes require fresh approval.

An approved Adaptation may reorganise or supplement content for teaching, but must not remove, distort or misstate substantive requirements, safety meaning, technical conclusions or revision status. The Provider must not make an abridgement that changes or obscures those matters.

Each reprint, Translation and Adaptation must credit Kestrelbank Standards Institute, identify the Licensed Standard and edition, retain applicable notices, and state conspicuously: "Adapted teaching material; not the unmodified Kestrelbank standard."

This Licence covers only the Licensed Standard identified in clause 2.1. The Term begins on the Effective Date and ends on the earlier of the recorded term end date, termination under clause 6, or the revision handling decision recorded in Schedule 5.

If the Licensor issues a revision or gives written supersession notice, the Provider must stop new enrolments and new reprinting or adaptation of the superseded material on the stated cessation date. A cohort already enrolled before that date may finish for the balance of its recorded 18-month cycle only if Schedule 5 expressly records the approved transition and end date; this does not extend the Term or permit a new cohort.

A party may terminate for material breach by written notice if the breach is not cured within a reasonable stated period where cure is possible. The Licensor may require immediate cessation where continued use is unauthorised or threatens material integrity.

On expiry or termination, the Provider must cease reprinting, adaptation, distribution and use of the Licensed Standard and Adaptations, except an expressly recorded existing-cohort transition under clause 5.2. It must withdraw remaining copies and course materials from further circulation, securely destroy or archive them without access or reuse, and confirm handling on request.

The fee is calculated per enrolled learner for each reported teaching period, at the rate and currency recorded in Schedule 4. No fee, currency or payment date is agreed until the corresponding Schedule 4 fields are completed.

Within the payment timing recorded in Schedule 4, the Provider must provide the learner report in Schedule 4: enrolled learner count, course/cohort identifier, teaching period, licensed-material use and any calculation adjustment. It must keep records supporting those reported items for the period recorded in Schedule 4.

On reasonable written notice, the Licensor or its appointed reviewer may inspect the Provider records reasonably necessary to verify the Schedule 4 learner report and per-learner calculation, during normal business hours and subject to reasonable confidentiality safeguards.

Except for the express permissions in this Licence, the Licensor gives no representation that an Adaptation meets the Provider’s course, learner or regulatory needs. The Provider remains responsible for its teaching delivery and for ensuring that its approved Adaptation is used within this Licence.
Each party must keep non-public commercial terms and submitted Adaptations confidential, except to advisers under confidence, as required by law, or as needed to perform this Licence.
Notices must be in writing and sent to the authorised contact and notice details recorded in Schedule 2. A notice is effective when received at those recorded details.

The selected Territory controls governing law and forum: where Schedule 2 selects Ontario, this Licence is governed by Ontario law and the Ontario courts; where it selects Scotland, it is governed by Scots law and the Scottish courts. The selected choice must be completed before signature.

This Licence and its Schedules are the entire agreement about the licensed use. Any amendment or waiver must be in writing and signed by both parties. Nothing transfers ownership of the Licensed Standard.
Schedules 1 to 5 form part of this Licence. If a Schedule field is marked TO COMPLETE, it is not agreed or operative until completed and confirmed as required by the Completion Guide.
Signed for and on behalf of Kestrelbank Standards Institute
Signed for and on behalf of the Provider

criteria.description: 该工作簿恰好包含四个必需的工作表，依次命名为“许可证”、“时间表”、“完成指南”和“审阅密钥”。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿工作表元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 openpyxl 打开并准确比较排序的工作表标题列表。

original.criterion: The workbook contains exactly the four required sheets named Licence, Schedules, Completion Guide, and Review Key, in that order.
original.grader_hint: Open with openpyxl and compare the ordered worksheet title list exactly.

criteria.description: 许可证表包含连贯的标题、文档状态指示和可识别的合同部分，而不是非结构化数据转储。
criteria.evidence: 许可表单元格和合并范围。
criteria.grader_hint: 手动或通过提取非空单元格文本检查标题和章节进度。

original.criterion: The Licence sheet contains a coherent title, document-status indication, and identifiable contractual sections rather than an unstructured data dump.
original.evidence: Licence sheet cells and merged ranges.
original.grader_hint: Inspect headings and section progression manually or by extracting non-empty cell text.

criteria.description: 该许可证将 Kestrelbank 标准协会确定为许可方，并包含所提供的提供商上下文，而不会发明不受支持的提供商条款。
criteria.evidence: 聚会和朗诵文本。
criteria.grader_hint: 根据资料包检查当事人文本，并确认未完成的字段未自动完成。

original.criterion: The Licence identifies Kestrelbank Standards Institute as the licensor and includes the supplied provider context without inventing unsupported provider terms.
original.grader_hint: Check party text against the fact pack and confirm pending fields are not silently completed.

criteria.description: 该文书包括许可标准或版本、改编、翻译、允许的用户或学习者以及地域的定义。
criteria.evidence: 定义部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 提取标题和子句文本；定义可以在表格中呈现。

original.criterion: The instrument includes definitions for the licensed standard or edition, adaptation, translation, permitted users or learners, and territory.
original.grader_hint: Extract headings and clause text; definitions may be presented in a table.

criteria.description: 许可版本标识符与商业资料包中的固定标识符一致。
criteria.evidence: 许可证和资料包比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较标准化版本字符串，而不是单元格坐标。

original.criterion: The licensed edition identifier agrees with the fixed identifier in the commercial fact pack.
original.grader_hint: Compare normalized edition strings, not cell coordinates.

criteria.description: 该赠款明确涵盖了允许课程使用的重印。
criteria.evidence: 权利授予条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻求操作许可，而不仅仅是提及重印的说明。

original.criterion: The grant expressly covers reprinting for permitted course use.
original.grader_hint: Look for an operative permission, not merely a recital mentioning reprints.

criteria.description: 该赠款明确允许翻译和课程改编。
criteria.evidence: 权利授予与改编时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 翻译和改编均须为可操作的权利。

original.criterion: The grant expressly permits translation and course adaptation.
original.grader_hint: Both translation and adaptation must be operative rights.

criteria.description: 改编许可及删减限制的定义方式，应确保该限制适用于允许的改编范围，同时不使翻译或课程改编失效。
criteria.evidence: 改编、完整性和删减条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪交叉引用，并测试在受保护的实质性内容不得被任意删除或歪曲的情况下，是否可以进行合理的课程改编。

original.criterion: The adaptation permission and the restriction on abridgement are defined so that the restriction applies to the permitted adaptation scope without nullifying translation or course adaptation.
original.grader_hint: Trace the cross-references and test whether a reasonable course adaptation can occur while protected substantive content cannot be arbitrarily removed or distorted.

criteria.description: 许可证说明了如何获得改编批准，并保留了已批准改编的记录。

criteria.description: 该文书包含署名和识别语言，防止将改编版本呈现为未经修改的 Kestrelbank 标准。
criteria.evidence: 署名与完整性条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查对 Kestrelbank 的致谢以及标准教材与改编教材之间的区分。

original.criterion: The instrument includes attribution and identification language preventing an adaptation from being presented as the unmodified Kestrelbank standard.
original.grader_hint: Check both credit to Kestrelbank and distinction between the standard and adapted teaching material.

criteria.description: 地域和被允许用户的规定支持安大略省和苏格兰的使用案例，并未授予无限制的世界范围权利。
criteria.evidence: 地域条款与地域时间表。
criteria.grader_hint: 将允许的司法管辖区与事实包进行比较，并检查范围限制。

original.criterion: The territory and permitted-user provisions support the Ontario and Scotland use cases and do not grant an unbounded worldwide right.
original.grader_hint: Compare allowed jurisdictions with the fact pack and inspect scope limitations.

criteria.description: 工作簿以审核人员可以为特定提供商实例进行选择或记录的方式区分了安大略省和苏格兰。
criteria.evidence: 地域时间表与填写字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受受控选择、清晰标记的字段或等效的结构化记录。

original.criterion: The workbook distinguishes Ontario and Scotland in a way a reviewer can select or record for a provider instance.
original.grader_hint: Accept a controlled choice, clearly labelled fields, or equivalent structured record.

criteria.description: 涉及司法管辖区敏感性的规定反映了提供的安大略省和苏格兰注释，且未引入无依据的立法或法律引用。
criteria.evidence: 许可证文本与 jurisdiction_and_rights_notes.pdf 的比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查来源一致性，并标记虚构的法令、判例或法律要求。

original.criterion: Jurisdiction-sensitive provisions reflect the supplied Ontario and Scotland notes and do not introduce unsupported legislation or legal citations.
original.grader_hint: Check for source alignment and flag invented statutes, cases, or legal requirements.

criteria.description: 工作簿包含针对相关司法管辖区可完成或选择的适用法律和管辖法院处理方案。
criteria.evidence: 适用法律条款与填写字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 该条款必须具有可操作性并具备司法管辖区意识，而不仅仅是一个标题。

original.criterion: The workbook contains a governing-law and forum treatment that can be completed or selected for the relevant jurisdiction.
original.grader_hint: The clause must be operational and jurisdiction-aware, not just a heading.

criteria.description: 期限条款防止权利延续超过所授予的版本或期限。
criteria.evidence: 期限与授予条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪授予是否具有与许可版本或合同期限相关的可识别终止条件。

original.criterion: The term clause prevents rights from continuing beyond the edition or term granted.
original.grader_hint: Trace whether the grant has an identifiable end condition tied to the licensed edition or contract term.

criteria.description: 修订触发的终止或取代需与 18 个月的同期群周期相协调，以确保文档既不默许到期后的使用，也不使所述的同期群事实无法管理。
criteria.evidence: 修订、同期群、期限及终止后条款加上事实包。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文书必须说明对现有同期群、通知、过渡或停止的可辩护处理方式，且不得自相矛盾。

original.criterion: Revision-triggered termination or supersession is reconciled with the 18-month cohort cycle so the document neither silently permits post-expiry use nor makes the stated cohort fact impossible to administer.
original.evidence: Revision, cohort, term, and post-termination clauses plus fact pack.
original.grader_hint: The instrument must state a defensible treatment of existing cohorts, notice, transition, or cessation and must not contradict itself.

criteria.description: 终止后条款涉及停止重印、改编、分发以及使用剩余副本或材料。
criteria.evidence: 终止后条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找对实体副本和改编/课程材料的处理方式。

original.criterion: The post-termination provisions address cessation of reprinting, adaptation, distribution, and use of remaining copies or materials.
original.grader_hint: Look for treatment of both physical copies and adapted/course materials.

criteria.description: 费用时间表使用了与商业事实包一致的每学员单位。
criteria.evidence: 费用时间表与事实包。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较单位概念和术语；待定金额或货币可以留空。

original.criterion: The fee schedule uses a per-learner unit consistent with the commercial fact pack.
original.grader_hint: Compare the unit concept and terminology; pending amount or currency may remain blank.

criteria.description: 报告条款要求提供足以计算每学员费用的信息，而不要求提供与许可使用无关的记录。
criteria.evidence: 费用与报告条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 审核人员应能够识别用于计算的学员人数、期间、课程/提供商背景以及任何排除项。

original.criterion: The reporting clause requires information sufficient to calculate the per-learner fee without demanding records unrelated to the licensed use.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to identify the learner count, period, course/provider context, and any exclusions needed for calculation.

criteria.description: 审计条款可以使用报告条款要求的记录实际验证基于学员的费用。
criteria.evidence: 报告、记录和审计条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查审计范围、保留或访问概念以及费用基础是否相互可用。

original.criterion: The audit clause can actually verify the learner-based fee using the records the reporting clause requires.
original.grader_hint: Check that the audit scope, retention or access concept, and fee basis are mutually usable.

criteria.description: 如果事实包将其列为待定，则费用、付款时间和货币仍为提供商特定，并标记为 TO COMPLETE（待完成）。
criteria.evidence: 费用时间表单元格与标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证输入单元格为空，且相邻标签包含确切的标记。

original.criterion: Fees, payment timing, and currency remain provider-specific where the fact pack leaves them pending and are marked TO COMPLETE.
original.grader_hint: Verify input cells are empty and adjacent labels contain the exact marker.

criteria.description: 该文书包含通知、授权联系人和通知详情，作为可识别的填写项目。
criteria.evidence: 通知条款与填写字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查机制和提供商特定的详细信息。

original.criterion: The instrument includes notices, authorised contacts, and notice details as identifiable completion items.
original.grader_hint: Check both the mechanism and the provider-specific details.

criteria.description: 签署部分包含双方的签名块，其中姓名、职务、日期和签名线在适当情况下保持待定状态。
criteria.evidence: 签名块。
criteria.grader_hint: 不得伪造签名细节。

original.criterion: The execution section contains signature blocks for both parties with names, titles, dates, and signature lines left pending where appropriate.
original.grader_hint: Signature particulars must not be fabricated.

criteria.description: 工作簿包含所有必需的时间表，且每个时间表均在主许可证中被引用。
criteria.evidence: 时间表工作表与交叉引用。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查时间表标题以及从许可证到每个时间表的至少一个有意义的引用。

original.criterion: The workbook contains all required schedules and each schedule is referenced from the main licence.
original.grader_hint: Check schedule titles and at least one meaningful reference from the licence to each.

criteria.description: 许可证和时间表使用一致的当事人、版本、地域、期限、改编和费用术语。
criteria.evidence: 跨工作表文本比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 规范化大小写和空白字符，然后检查可能产生歧义的重要同义词。

original.criterion: The licence and schedules use consistent party, edition, territory, term, adaptation, and fee terminology.
original.grader_hint: Normalize case and whitespace, then inspect material synonyms that could create ambiguity.

criteria.description: 完成指南解释了哪些字段由权利编辑完成，哪些需要提供商或委员会确认。
criteria.evidence: 完成指南工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 指南必须分配责任，而不仅仅是列出空白单元格。

original.criterion: The Completion Guide explains which fields are completed by the rights editor and which require provider or committee confirmation.
original.grader_hint: The guide must assign responsibility, not merely list blank cells.

criteria.description: 完成指南解释了司法管辖区选择以及签署前关于改编批准、费用基础、期限和签名的检查。
criteria.evidence: 完成指南工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查是否存在可执行但简洁的交接指导。

original.criterion: The Completion Guide explains jurisdiction selection and the pre-signature checks for adaptation approval, fee basis, term, and signatures.
original.grader_hint: Check for actionable but concise handoff guidance.

criteria.description: 审查密钥标识了支持每项重要起草决定的来源或专业判断。
criteria.evidence: 审查密钥工作表。
criteria.grader_hint: 涵盖权利、司法管辖区、期限、同期群、费用和审计主题的示例条目；接受来源名称或明确的判断标签。

original.criterion: The Review Key identifies the source or professional judgment supporting each material drafting decision.
original.grader_hint: Sample entries across rights, jurisdiction, term, cohort, fee, and audit topics; accept source names or explicit judgment labels.

criteria.description: 审查密钥提供了关于改编与删减之间一致预期处理方式。
criteria.evidence: 审查密钥与相应的许可证条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 将密钥中陈述的裁决与操作性措辞进行比较。

original.criterion: The Review Key gives a consistent intended treatment for adaptation versus abridgement.
original.evidence: Review Key and corresponding licence clauses.
original.grader_hint: Compare the key's stated verdict with the operative wording.

criteria.description: 审查密钥提供了关于修订、终止和现有同期群的一致预期处理方式。
criteria.evidence: 审查密钥与相应的许可证条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 密钥不得认可许可证阻止的结果，也不得遗漏同期群问题。

original.criterion: The Review Key gives a consistent intended treatment for revision, termination, and existing cohorts.
original.evidence: Review Key and corresponding licence clauses.
original.grader_hint: The key must not endorse a result the licence prevents or omit the cohort issue.

criteria.description: 审查密钥提供了关于每学员费用、报告和可审计性的一致预期处理方式。
criteria.evidence: 审查关键条款、费用表、报告和审计条款。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查密钥的预期计算和记录是否与合同语言一致。

original.criterion: The Review Key gives a consistent intended treatment for per-learner fees, reporting, and auditability.
original.evidence: Review Key, fee schedule, reporting and audit clauses.
original.grader_hint: Check that the key's expected calculation and records match the contract language.

criteria.description: 特定于提供商的输入单元格为空，没有文本、数字或公式。
criteria.evidence: 已识别完成范围内的单元格值和公式。
criteria.grader_hint: 定位标记为确切“TO COMPLETE”标记的单元格，并检查其关联的输入单元格。

original.criterion: The provider-specific input cells are empty of text, numbers, and formulas.
original.evidence: Cell values and formulas in identified completion ranges.
original.grader_hint: Locate cells labelled by the exact TO COMPLETE marker and inspect their associated input cells.

criteria.description: 每个特定于提供商的空白处都伴有确切的文本“TO COMPLETE”，且该标记不作为固定事实内容的替代品使用。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿单元格文本及相邻标签。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查许可证和附表中的所有待处理字段，并将固定事实与事实包进行比较。

original.criterion: Every provider-specific blank is accompanied by the exact text TO COMPLETE and the marker is not used as a substitute for fixed factual content.
original.evidence: Workbook cell text and adjacent labels.
original.grader_hint: Check all pending fields in Licence and Schedules and compare fixed facts against the fact pack.

criteria.description: 完成单元格通过颜色以外的更多方式与固定文本在视觉上区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 单元格样式、边框、标签和措辞。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查渲染后的工作表和样式元数据中的标签、边框、填充或提示。

original.criterion: Completion cells are visually distinguishable from fixed text through more than colour alone.
original.evidence: Cell styles, borders, labels, and wording.
original.grader_hint: Inspect rendered sheets and style metadata for labels, borders, fill, or prompts.

criteria.description: 工作簿提供了有用的导航功能，如冻结窗格、超链接或一致易读的章节结构。
criteria.evidence: 工作表视图和导航元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果跨职能用户可以在不丢失上下文的情况下浏览长工作表，则授予奖项。

original.criterion: The workbook provides useful navigation such as frozen panes, hyperlinks, or a consistently readable section structure.
original.grader_hint: Award where a cross-functional user can move through long sheets without losing context.

criteria.description: 当使用计算或跨表引用来确定衍生费用、学员总数或检查清单状态时，应将其实现为公式而非粘贴的常量。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式单元格。
criteria.grader_hint: 仅评估工作簿实际包含的计算；不要要求不必要的公式。

original.criterion: Where a calculation or cross-sheet reference is used for a derived fee, learner total, or checklist status, it is implemented as a formula rather than a pasted constant.
original.grader_hint: Only assess calculations the workbook actually includes; do not require unnecessary formulas.

criteria.description: 工作簿具有适合许可证和附表的打印设置，包括定义的纸张大小、可读的方向、适应宽度或等效缩放，以及在工作表跨页时重复显示的上下文信息。
criteria.evidence: 工作表页面设置和打印标题元数据。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查 page_setup, page_margins, print_area, 和 print_title_rows；判断可读性而不是要求任意的页数。

original.criterion: The workbook has print settings suitable for the Licence and Schedules, including a defined paper size, readable orientation, fit-to-width or equivalent scaling, and repeated context where a sheet spans pages.
original.evidence: Worksheet page setup and print-title metadata.
original.grader_hint: Inspect page_setup, page_margins, print_area, and print_title_rows; judge readability rather than demanding an arbitrary page count.

criteria.description: 渲染后的许可证和附表不会在页面边界处裁剪合同文本、表格标题、完成标记或签名行。
criteria.evidence: 离线 PDF 渲染或打印预览。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果有 LibreOffice 则使用其进行渲染，或使用 pypdf 检查打印区域和生成的 PDF；手动审查页面边缘。

original.criterion: The rendered Licence and Schedules do not clip contractual text, table headings, completion markers, or signature lines at page boundaries.
original.evidence: Offline PDF render or print preview.
original.grader_hint: Render with LibreOffice if available or inspect print areas and generated PDF using pypdf; manually review page edges.

criteria.description: 工作簿打开和重新加载时没有修复警告、损坏的公式或损坏的工作表 XML。
criteria.evidence: 离线 openpyxl 重新加载和归档完整性。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用 openpyxl 加载工作簿，检查公式和关系，并验证 ZIP 包是否有效。

original.criterion: The workbook opens and reloads without repair warnings, broken formulas, or corrupted worksheet XML.
original.evidence: Offline openpyxl reload and archive integrity.
original.grader_hint: Load the workbook with openpyxl, inspect formulas and relationships, and check that the ZIP package is valid.

criteria.description: 权利编辑、财务审查人员和培训利益相关者无需单独解释即可理解哪些是固定的，哪些是待处理的，以及哪些必须经过批准。
criteria.evidence: 整体渲染的工作簿。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估实际交接可用性、层级、措辞和可发现性，而不仅仅是检查工作表是否存在。

original.criterion: A rights editor, finance reviewer, and training stakeholder can understand what is fixed, what is pending, and what must be approved without needing a separate explanation.
original.grader_hint: Judge practical handoff usability, hierarchy, wording, and discoverability rather than merely checking that sheets exist.

criteria.description: 工作簿读起来像一份可签署的许可证，而不是论文或检查清单，其中的合同语言、附表和执行块可按顺序使用。
criteria.evidence: 渲染后的许可证和附表。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估委员会在完成标记字段后是否可以审查并签署该文书。

original.criterion: The workbook reads as a signable licence rather than an essay or checklist, with contractual language, schedules, and execution blocks usable in sequence.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a committee could review and sign the instrument after completing the marked fields.

criteria.description: 起草风格克制且在专业上站得住脚：它解决了核心歧义，而没有过度主张法律、捏造事实或添加无关的操作材料。
criteria.evidence: 完整工作簿与所有提供的参考资料进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 使用专家审查，重点关注范围纪律、内部一致性、源保真度以及对所述业务需求的适用性。

original.criterion: The drafting is restrained and professionally defensible: it closes the central ambiguities without overclaiming law, inventing facts, or adding irrelevant operational material.
original.evidence: Complete workbook compared with all supplied references.
original.grader_hint: Use expert review focused on scope discipline, internal consistency, source fidelity, and suitability for the stated business need.

review.selection: 沿用旧review-500中南杨c0–c3固定随机100题，未重抽、未挑题。

validation_record.label: 结构/材料验收记录
validation_record.detail: validated 属于结构、防泄漏、材料推进验收；没有内容正确率结论。

author_policy_self_report_not_verified.reviewer_policy: A domain-experienced licensing reviewer checks the contractual coherence and source fidelity, while an independent spreadsheet reviewer checks blank-field behavior, keyed consistency, workbook structure, printability, and clean offline execution.
known_limitations: The supplied jurisdiction notes are internal source material rather than a complete legal opinion; grading should assess fidelity and restraint against those notes, not independent legal correctness beyond them.
Rendered page flow can vary slightly between spreadsheet engines, so geometry review should focus on clipping, readability, and signability rather than exact pagination unless explicitly asserted.

spec.professional_context: Milena Bonneau is preparing a reusable licensing instrument for Kestrelbank Standards Institute, with Carsten Gallagher chairing the licensing committee. The document will be reviewed by cross-functional legal, training, rights, and finance stakeholders before it is issued to two Ontario colleges and a Scottish training provider.
difficulty_sources: Reconciling adaptation and translation rights with an abridgement restriction
Aligning edition-revision termination with an 18-month teaching cohort cycle
Making the per-learner fee and audit rights operationally consistent
Comparing Ontario and Scotland requirements without importing unsupported precedent terms
Designing a reusable signable instrument while keeping provider-specific commercial terms visibly incomplete

workbook.purpose: The workbook is both a reusable blank instrument and a keyed review package. The Licence and Schedules contain the signable text and blank provider fields. Completion Guide explains handoff use. Review Key records the expected treatment of the supplied facts, the interaction among provisions, and the rationale or judgment behind each material choice.

required_sections: edition, revision notice, and cohort treatment
governing law and forum options for Ontario and Scotland

fields: provider legal name if not fixed by the selected instance
blank_field_policy.implementation: The actual input cells remain empty; the adjacent label or instruction cell contains exactly TO COMPLETE. Do not place examples, placeholder names, zeroes, or formulas in the input cells.

relationships: The licensed edition must match the revised edition in the fact pack.
The fee unit must be per learner and must be the same unit used by the reporting and audit provisions.
The cohort cycle must be represented without granting rights beyond the licence term or revised-edition controls.
Ontario and Scotland selections must be distinguishable and must map to the corresponding governing-law treatment.

must_cover: which blanks the rights editor completes
which entries need committee or provider confirmation
how to select and record jurisdiction
completion_guide.design: Concise operational guidance, visibly separate from contractual text, with no replacement for the contract.

must_cover: interaction between revision termination and 18-month cohorts
unsupported or unresolved matters that remain TO COMPLETE
a reviewer checklist for internal approval
review_key.answerability: Every material drafting issue in the key must point to a clause or schedule location and state the intended verdict or acceptable treatment. The key must not contradict the licence.

formatting_and_print.use: Electronic review followed by printed signature circulation.
requirements: Licence and Schedules are print-ready with repeated title or header context where needed.
Fixed text and completion cells are distinguishable through labels, fill or borders, and wording rather than colour alone.
Navigation is practical for a cross-functional reviewer.
No logos or invented branding assets are required.

source_content.single_territory_uk_print_precedent.docx: Create a short internal precedent with UK print-only grant language, a narrow territory clause, a simple term, a fixed fee paragraph, signature blocks, and at least two omissions or tensions that the new instrument must correct.
source_content.jurisdiction_and_rights_notes.pdf: Create offline source notes with clearly separated Ontario and Scotland material. Include supported distinctions concerning adaptation/translation permissions, attribution or moral-rights-sensitive handling, approval, governing law/forum, notices, and enforcement. Phrase them as supplied internal notes or extracts, not as a comprehensive legal opinion.
source_content.commercial_terms_and_facts.xlsx: Create an internal fact pack with the revised edition identifier, the two Ontario colleges and Scottish provider, the 18-month cohort fact, the proposed per-learner commercial basis, reporting expectations, committee and rights-editor roles, and facts that must remain pending. Include duplicates, malformed labels, and irrelevant rows so the solver must clean and restructure the facts without making the answer depend on arbitrary cell positions.

authoring_plan.gold_derivation: Build a professionally usable workbook from the sources. The gold must preserve fixed source facts, leave all provider-specific terms empty, explicitly mark them TO COMPLETE, and include a consistent keyed rationale. Test the workbook with openpyxl for sheet order, formulas or references where used, empty input cells, marker placement, print settings, and clean reload. Render or convert the Licence and Schedules to PDF and inspect page readability and signature usability offline.

reference_files.purpose: House precedent showing the existing UK print-only licence language and its limitations; use it as a draft to assess, not as controlling text.
reference_files.discovery: Review this document first to identify reusable concepts, omissions, and provisions that conflict with the new multi-jurisdiction adaptation arrangement.

reference_files.purpose: Supplied source extracts and internal notes for comparing the Ontario and Scotland arrangements, including rights, attribution, approval, governing-law, and enforcement considerations.
reference_files.discovery: Use the Ontario and Scotland sections when drafting jurisdiction-sensitive provisions; do not supplement them with internet research.

reference_files.purpose: Internal fact pack containing the revised-edition identifier, provider and cohort facts, proposed fee basis, reporting information, approval roles, and operational constraints.
reference_files.discovery: Use this workbook to populate fixed factual terms and to identify which fields must remain pending for provider or committee completion.

deliverables.description: A keyed, reusable Excel licence instrument with a signable licence, schedules, completion guidance, and a reviewer-facing decision key.
constraints: Use exactly the sheets Licence, Schedules, Completion Guide, and Review Key.
Provider-specific terms must remain empty and be identified by an adjacent TO COMPLETE marker.
The workbook must contain the fixed facts and source-supported drafting decisions without inventing provider terms.
The licence and schedules must be suitable for electronic circulation and printing for signature.
The workbook must open cleanly without repair warnings and must retain usable navigation and formatting.

original_instruction:
You are Milena Bonneau, rights editor at Kestrelbank Standards Institute. Carsten Gallagher needs a signable reprint-and-adaptation licence ready for the licensing committee's review by 4:00 p.m. on Friday, because two Ontario colleges and a Scottish training provider are waiting to build their next bridge-inspection courses around the revised Kestrelbank standard. The only house precedent, `single_territory_uk_print_precedent.docx`, was written for a UK print-only arrangement, so do not simply copy it into this new instrument. Use `jurisdiction_and_rights_notes.pdf` for the supplied Ontario and Scotland material and use `commercial_terms_and_facts.xlsx` for the edition, cohort, fee, provider, and approval facts; these are the only reference materials you should rely on, and where they do not settle a point, make a restrained and defensible drafting choice rather than inventing a local rule. Create `kestrelbank_reprint_adaptation_licence.xlsx` in the top level of the working directory.
